annotations.text:
Five right-dock contexts the newest design set never draws.
Every measurement is lifted from 05-right-dock-and-bars.md — 304 px dock, 14 px pad, 24 px controls, 28 px rows, 26 px hero, and the same key/value row geometry the drawn contexts use.
History is deliberately STAMP STACK's twin rather than a new panel.

Religion sits as a fifth CIVIL accordion, using 04-left-dock.md §6's exact header row (chevron, .18em caps, right-hand count).
Its table follows Azgaar's Religions editor — swatch, name, type, share, trend, sortable — because that is the closest comparable that already works.
The Data-manager pane is a PATTERN: one pane drawn so the other eleven routes inherit it instead of being designed one at a time.

One modal pattern replaces every stock ConfirmationDialog and AcceptDialog in the shell — the asset-library prompts, app.gd's two confirms, and the import warnings.
The status-bar states are the four the spec's single priority message cannot express.
